elaine: Follow-up from INC-3245 postmortem: we need a single-runbook fragment that covers detection, immediate triage, and an explicit rollback/mitigation checklist for cache-eviction during autoscale. I sketched a short draft below. Claim items please.

omar: I can own the runbook fragment and PR.

jiho: Ill own the rollback mitigation steps + test plan.

elaine: Draft runbook fragment (paste verbatim into docs/incidents/cache-evictions.md):
1) detection: alert fires when increase(redis_evictions[5m]) > 5 AND p95_redis_latency > 300ms. Classify as SLO-impact if latency > 500ms.
2) immediate triage commands (collect before any restart):
```
kubectl -n infra logs -l app=cache --since=30m | egrep -i "evict|OOM|killed"
redwood-metrics query "increase(redis_evictions[5m])"
kubectl top pods -n infra --containers
kubectl -n kube-system logs deploy/cluster-autoscaler --since=1h | grep -i scale
```
3) quick mitigation (do in order):
- scale cache replica set +2 replicas (kubectl scale rs cache-xyz --replicas=$(($(kubectl get rs cache-xyz -o jsonpath='{.status.replicas}')+2)))
- set pod disruption budget to prevent simultaneous evictions 
- if immediate relief needed, cordon problematic node and drain non-critical pods
4) rollback path: if mitigation fails or latency worsens after 10m, revert autoscaler config to previous canary (documented in infra-canary repo) and open high-priority incident.

elaine: Owners + deadlines (please confirm):
- omar: open PR with runbook fragment + paste ACTION id in PR body (due 2367893600)
- jiho: write rollback steps and a small runbook appendix for oncall to execute (due 2367897200)

incidents-bot: ACTION-7010 created: owner=omar due=2367893600

omar: Ill open PR in ~45m. Will include the exact metric thresholds and the SLO classification language.

jiho: Ill draft the rollback playbook and a simple k6 test to simulate bursty writes for the autoscaler test (ACTION-7011, due 2367950000).

ops-bot: Note: include a step to upload evidence to s3://redwood-incident-evidence/inc-3245/{{date}}/ and include the autoscaler commit hash if rollback is performed.

oncall: Acknowledged. When paged Ill run the triage commands and attempt the quick mitigation steps; will post results and include ACTION numbers in the incident channel.

elaine: We'll have a 15m check-in Thu to confirm PR merge and rollback appendix. If any item slips, escalate to infra lead by EOD.

incidents-bot: ACTION-7010 status: open (owner: omar); ACTION-7011 status: open (owner: jiho).
